name: e-Health (Partner)
desc:
Independent Sales Agent (1099, Licensed Medicare/Health Insurance) | Commission-Only, Uncapped | Phone Heavy, Requires 5+ Active Licenses
Company: eHealth
Industry: Insurance | Health Insurance Marketplace, Independent Contractor Sales
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 eHealth is an online health insurance marketplace, and this role has you working as a genuinely independent contractor (1099, not an employee) helping people, mostly Medicare beneficiaries, choose the right health insurance coverage. eHealth provides the leads through their own marketing (inbound calls from people already interested), so you're not cold prospecting, but you may occasionally follow up on your own pipeline with outbound calls.
This is a real, established insurance professional's role, not an entry point. You're expected to already know the products, carry your own liability insurance, and be fully licensed and certified before you take a single call. Peak season (AEP, the Medicare Annual Enrollment Period) means significantly extended hours, including evenings and weekends.
assessment: After completing the application, you are required to complete an online assessment before moving forward to the interview process
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not specified in posting.
 Required Experience: 12 months of proven Medicare Insurance Sales experience as an independent agent, OR 24 months selling ACA, Final Expense, Annuities, or Life Insurance.
 Preferred Experience: Not separately broken out.
 Required Credentials (hard requirements, not preferences):
Current AHIP Certification for 2026
Personal Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance
Minimum of 5 active Health Licenses at time of contracting, with ability to acquire 10-15 total before taking calls
If currently appointed with Medicare carriers, must be able to become reappointed
Own compatible computer (Windows 11 or macOS Sonoma or later, 8GB RAM minimum)
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
An already-licensed, experienced Medicare or health insurance sales professional looking for a flexible, commission-only opportunity with free inbound leads
Someone comfortable with a true 1099 contractor relationship (no benefits, self-employment taxes)
Anyone who wants uncapped earning potential and already has the infrastructure (licenses, E&O insurance, equipment) in place
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without existing active health insurance licenses, this is not a training-to-license pathway
Participants new to insurance sales or looking for an entry-level opportunity
Someone who needs guaranteed income, this is 100% commission with no base pay
Anyone unable to pass a lifetime criminal background and credit history check, this is explicitly required and more extensive than most postings in our database
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Independent insurance agent
Medicare sales
AHIP certification
Health insurance licensing
E&O insurance
Commission-based sales
CMS/TCPA compliance
Non-captive agent
Inbound lead conversion
1099 contractor
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you.
If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen.
If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview.
 Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about your Medicare or health insurance sales experience and how many years you've been licensed.
How many active health insurance licenses do you currently hold, and in which states?
Do you currently carry your own E&O insurance, or would you need to obtain it?
How do you handle a genuinely commission-only income structure, especially during slower periods outside of AEP?
What's your comfort level with extended AEP hours, including evenings and weekends?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: Commission-only, uncapped, paid bi-weekly. No base salary.
Shift: Flexible, independent contractor schedule. Peak call volume 8am-1pm PST Monday-Friday outside AEP; during AEP, 8am-1pm and 5pm-8pm PST Monday-Friday, plus 10am-1pm PST weekends.
Benefits: None, this is a 1099 non-employee contractor role with no employee benefits. eHealth provides free inbound leads, CRM access, and support infrastructure instead.
Equipment Provided: No. Contractor must supply their own Windows or Mac computer meeting specific technical requirements.
Felony Friendly?: Explicitly not accessible for most records. The posting confirms all candidates undergo a lifetime criminal background check and credit history report, more extensive than a standard background check, and passing is a stated condition of contracting. Combined with the health insurance licensing requirement itself (which carries separate state-level felony restrictions for fraud/dishonesty convictions), this role has multiple layers of background scrutiny.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting.
Notes: This is genuinely not a fit for our typical entry-level or career-change participant population, it requires someone who is already a fully licensed, experienced insurance professional with their own business infrastructure (E&O insurance, equipment, multiple state licenses). Only relevant if a participant already works in insurance sales and is looking to add a flexible, commission-based lead source. Not recommended as a general database entry given the specialized entry bar.
Career Pathway: Independent Sales Agent (1099) → Senior Independent Agent → Agency Owner/Book of Business Builder (this is a career track built around growing one's own independent book of business over time, not a traditional internal promotion ladder)
